best_for: Self-publishers and ebook producers who want to fix or build EPUB files by hand, and are comfortable reading the HTML and CSS inside a book.
description:
Sigil is an ebook editor first created by Strahinja Markovic in 2009. Today Doug Massay and Kevin Hendricks lead and maintain it, with help from volunteers who add code, translations and answers to user questions. It suits people formatting books for their own reading as well as editors who publish on several platforms.

You can import existing EPUB and HTML files along with images and style sheets, have Sigil mend the formatting of what you bring in, and optionally tidy the code so it is easier to read. It has full UTF-16 support for text in any script, an interface translated into many languages, and icon themes you can swap to change its look.

points.title: An EPUB editor, not a word processor
points.text: Sigil opens the files inside an EPUB. You edit the markup in Code View and check the result in Preview, so some HTML and CSS knowledge helps.

points.title: Both EPUB versions
points.text: It works with EPUB 2 and EPUB 3 books.

points.title: Tools for cleanup
points.text: It has a table of contents generator, a metadata editor, spell checking, regex find and replace, and checkpoints to compare changes.

points.title: Python plugins
points.text: Plugins extend it. Version 2.8.6 fixed several plugin issues and an EPUB 3 cover-image bug in 2.8.5 that could damage the book's manifest, so update if you are on 2.8.5.

points.title: Free, volunteer-run
points.text: Sigil is GPLv3 software with no price, written and supported by volunteers.

points.title: Linux Flatpak is not the project's
points.text: Flathub does not mark the Flatpak as verified. The project itself ships an AppImage that needs glibc 2.35 or newer.

points.title: Install details
points.text: Windows gets a 64-bit installer for all users that needs Windows 10 version 1809 or later. Macs need macOS 13, with Intel and Apple silicon builds. Windows keeps 26 versions; macOS and Linux list only the current release.
